data.description:
Goal:
Replace the unsafe same-path generation design with the provider-protected protocol-v2 contract used by every later compaction component.

Verification:
1. Run cargo test compaction and confirm the manifest, vector, pack, activation, and rollback models pass.
2. Run the released v0.17.6 compatibility fixture and confirm legacy writes cannot alter .knots/v2 canonical hashes.
3. Run make sanity and confirm formatting, lint, tests, and coverage pass.

Constraints:
Use separate legacy, canonical/control, archive, and credential-scoped inbox refs plus the .knots/v2 namespace. Disable the shipped 5728 direct-publication and local-prune path unless a provider-protected control marker validates. Retain every archive and raw event pack indefinitely.
